== Build notes ==
* Scan: Internet Archive item star-wars-insider-56b702 (same PDF as Star Wars Insider 048 (2000) in the 1–153 collection). The page images are 1224×1584 from the jp2 set; the PDF's own images are 584×754. Wayback refuses to save archive.org pages (25 October 2026). The scan is cited as the Internet Archive item itself.
* Player cards: the lore boxes are too small to read at this resolution, so only the game text and stats are transcribed. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 02:11, 26 October 2026 (UTC)
